item.title: What’s Left of Iran’s Air Force After Operation Epic Fury
item.description: Before Operation Epic Fury began on February 28, 2026, Iran’s air force was already in trouble. Decades of sanctions had left its fighter fleet aging, parts-starved, and increasingly difficult to sustain. item.title: AB910 Flies Again: The Spitfire That Flew on D-Day Returns to the Air
item.description: After more than two years on the ground, Supermarine Spitfire Mk Vb AB910 flew again on January 28, 2025, completing its post-maintenance air test from Biggin Hill.
